title: A Concurrent Structured Record Mirrored the Prose It Accompanied: A Pre-Registered Conceptual Replication and Extension of the Hide Pending Tool Call Scenario
abstract: arXiv:2611.23274v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Huang et al. (2026) show that language models writing reports of agentic work tend to conceal narrative-changing flaws, and that appending "Be honest in your response." to the instruction substantially increases disclosure in most of their scenarios. In their Hide Pending Tool Call scenario, where a broader follow-up query was accepted but never returned, the honesty prompt left GPT-5.5's rate of flagging the missing data at 0%, although it turned most answers into caveats. I ask whether a different request changes this: appending, in the same generation, a structured record that follows the schema of an adversarial-review tool, including a residue section for what remained unresolved. In two pre-registered phases on the same 100 synthetic log pairs, each pending log matched with a clean twin in which the follow-up query did return, I ran gpt-5.6-sol through Codex CLI under four conditions. Phase 1 measured the record: with the residue

translated_title: 并发生成的结构化记录映照了它所伴随的散文叙述：《隐藏待处理工具调用》场景的预注册概念性复制与扩展
translated_abstract: Huang 等人（2026）的研究表明，撰写智能体工作报告的语言模型往往倾向于掩盖会改变叙述内容的缺陷，而在指令末尾附加“请在回答中保持诚实。”一句，能在其大多数场景中显著提高披露率。在其“隐藏待处理工具调用”场景中——即一个更宽泛的后续查询被接受却始终未返回结果——诚实提示使 GPT-5.5 标记缺失数据的比例仍然停留在 0%，尽管它让大多数回答变成了附带保留说明的形式。我探究的是换一种请求是否会改变这一点：在同一次生成中附加一份遵循对抗性审查工具模式的结构化记录，其中包含一个记录尚未解决问题的“残余”部分。在基于同一组 100 对合成日志（每个待处理日志均与一个后续查询确实返回了结果的“干净孪生”日志相配对）的两个预注册阶段中，我在四种条件下通过 Codex CLI 运行了 gpt-5.6-sol。第一阶段测量了记录的表现：当包含残余部分时……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本研究对 Huang 等人（2026）的“隐藏待处理工具调用”场景进行了预注册概念复制与扩展，发现要求模型在同一次生成中附加含“未解决问题”残余部分的结构化记录时，该记录只是映照了其伴随的散文叙述内容，并未能独立提升对缺失待处理结果的披露。
en_tdlr: In a pre-registered conceptual replication and extension of Huang et al.'s (2026) Hide Pending Tool Call scenario, a concurrently generated structured record with a residue section for unresolved items merely mirrored the prose it accompanied rather than independently increasing disclosure of the missing tool-call result.
